clips.title: The story
paras: Deadeye Shore lies windswept along Durotar’s eastern edge, east of Drygulch Ravine. Named for Kilrogg Deadeye, the Bleeding Hollow chieftain, its barren sands are roamed by raptors, scorpids, and feral boars.

Deadeye Shore runs beneath central Durotar’s red bluffs, with sand and rocky outcrops that faintly resemble a skull missing an eye socket. The coast takes its name from Kilrogg Deadeye, the one-eyed Bleeding Hollow chieftain who fought in the First and Second Wars. No major settlement or military outpost holds the shore. It is far from peaceful: aggressive wildlife rules the sands, and Burning Blade cultists from nearby ravine hideouts have been seen prowling toward the water.
